component.name: Innkeeper
component.summary: Run Android and OpenHarmony apps on Linux

description.p: Innkeeper runs Android and OpenHarmony apps on Linux. Each Android app gets its own window, app menu entry and icon. Apps play sound and use the desktop's clipboard, notifications and file pickers. Android runs without root, in a sandboxed session.
A profile can run OpenHarmony instead. OpenHarmony support is experimental, and its built-in apps show in one phone window.
